title: 2017 Prairie's porch parapet and chimney match its photograph
items: The porch on the William Armour house at 2017 Prairie now has the parapet its photograph shows: a solid stone band pierced with a row of round openings, with a ball finial on each front corner, in place of a plain balustrade.
Its front chimney now rises from the mansard's cornice at the very edge of the house, where the photograph puts it, and stands a little taller.
